news.headline: Global Oil Supply Buffer Running ‘Scarily Thin,’ Aramco CEO Says
news.summary: The oil stockpiles that cushion the world from supply shocks have become “scarily thin,” putting markets at risk of worsening unless the Strait of Hormuz reopens, according to the head of Saudi Arabia’s Aramco.

news.headline: Iran’s Oil Minister Resigns as Exports Dry Up Under US Pressure
news.summary: Iran’s Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned citing personal reasons, as the Islamic Republic tries to sustain its oil industry under a tightening US blockade.

news.headline: LNG Trade Through Hormuz Extends Rebound Despite Shipping Risks
news.summary: Shipments of liquefied natural gas through the Strait of Hormuz extended a rebound that began in September, as the region’s producers seek to restore supplies to energy-starved customers.

news.headline: China Oil Comeback Loses Steam as Iran War Drags On
news.summary: A nascent recovery in Chinese oil demand has begun to falter, as continued fighting in the Middle East and limited Iranian supply keep crude prices too high for private refiners.

news.headline: Euro-Zone Inflation Tops Estimates to Hit Three-Year High
news.summary: Euro-area inflation quickened more than expected to the highest in three years, bolstering expectations that the European Central Bank will lift interest rates further.

news.headline: Europe’s Bond-Spread Blowout Prompts Bets on Fewer ECB Hikes
news.summary: A surge in euro-area sovereign bond spreads slowed as traders bet the European Central Bank will deliver fewer interest-rate hikes to support more-indebted members.

news.headline: ECB Hopeful Knot Says Market Access At Risk If Nations Cut Rules
news.summary: Europe may have to reconsider the market access it gives other jurisdictions that are rapidly relaxing their financial regulations, ECB presidency candidate Klaas Knot said.

news.headline: Yen Strengthens Past 157 Per Dollar, Outperforming G-10 Peers
news.summary: The yen strengthened past the 157 level against the dollar as government warnings on the currency and quarter-end flows provided support.

news.headline: Shell’s LNG Canada to Proceed With Multibillion-Dollar Expansion
news.summary: Shareholders in the Shell-led LNG Canada venture made a final investment decision to expand liquefied natural gas exports on a multibillion-dollar plan.

news.headline: Man Group Says 5.5% Yields Risk Cracking AI Capex, US Consumer
news.summary: Man Group’s Kristina Hooper warned that surging long-end Treasury yields threaten AI capital expenditures and US consumer resilience.

news.headline: Pimco’s Stracke Says AI Spending Drove Yields, Not Inflation
news.summary: Surging capital demand from hyperscalers and the AI ecosystem—not inflation expectations—is the primary force pushing real rates and bond yields higher, Pimco’s Stracke said.

news.headline: UK Firms Predict Faster Price Increases After Energy Costs Surge
news.summary: The resurgence in oil and gas prices drove up UK businesses’ inflation expectations as firms planned to pass on cost increases to consumers.
